items.title: What a harness is and how to build one with Claude Agent SDK
items.summary: Claire Vo 使用 Claude Agent SDK、Ink 库及 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 构建了针对 ChatPRD 的自动化错误调试系统。该方案通过集成 Sentry、Linear、GitHub 和 Vercel 适配器，实现了证据收集、根因分析及后续产物生成的全流程自动化。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Agent SDK，助力开发者构建自动化工作流。
items.summary_en: The article demonstrates building an AI harness using the Claude Agent SDK and Ink library to automate bug debugging workflows for ChatPRD. This custom solution integrates adapters for Sentry, Linear, GitHub, and Vercel to handle evidence gathering and root-cause analysis without manual prompting. The creator utilized Claude Opus and GPT-5.5 via Codex to develop the harness architecture, which includes specific permissions and structured artifact outputs.

items.title: Rewriting Bun in Rust
items.summary: Jarred Sumner利用Mythos/Fable等前沿模型代理，耗时11天将Bun从Zig重写为Rust，主要解决了内存管理带来的崩溃问题并提升了代码安全性。该过程通过TypeScript编写的百万级断言测试套件作为合规标准，结合对抗性审查自动化完成了大规模代码转换，尽管消耗了约1650万美元当量的API算力成本，但最终使Linux平台启动速度提升10%。
items.why_now: Bun Rust版6月17日上线，AI重写千万行代码成现实。
items.summary_en: Jarred Sumner successfully rewrote Bun from Zig to Rust using an agentic engineering workflow powered by Claude models, leveraging a TypeScript conformance suite to automate the port. The project consumed approximately $165,000 in API tokens and 5.9 billion uncached input tokens, resulting in a stable implementation that improved startup speed on Linux. This rewrite demonstrates how large-scale software refactoring can be managed through coordinated parallel agents and automated testing rather than manual intervention.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: 该开源框架基于 Claude Code 构建，提供从简历定制、求职信撰写到面试准备的自动化求职工作流。用户通过 `/setup` 配置资料，利用 `/scrape` 搜索并评估职位匹配度，最后通过 `/apply` 命令生成并优化申请材料。
items.summary_en: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search is an open-source framework leveraging Claude Code to automate job applications by evaluating role fit, tailoring CVs, and drafting cover letters. The tool features a modular workflow for self-profiling, scraping Danish job portals, and generating LaTeX documents, supported by a reviewer agent for quality assurance.

items.title: bradautomates/claude-video
items.summary: bradautomates/claude-video 是一款插件，赋予 Claude 观看视频的能力，支持 YouTube、Loom 等主流平台及本地文件。其核心流程利用 yt-dlp 优先获取免费字幕，若无则通过 Whisper API 提取音频，并结合 ffmpeg 场景感知帧提取技术，将视觉与听觉信息整合后由 Claude 进行分析。该工具实现了从猜测标题到精准理解视频内容的跨越，显著提升了视频摘要、竞品分析和故障诊断的效率。
items.why_now: 刚发布支持Claude的视频分析插件，填补多模态能力空白。

items.title: kyutai-labs/pocket-tts
items.summary: Kyutai Labs发布的Pocket TTS是一款仅含1亿参数、可在CPU上高效运行的轻量级语音合成模型，支持Python及CLI操作。其核心优势在于低延迟（首块音频约200ms）和高效率（在MacBook Air M4上可达实时6倍速），同时具备声音克隆、多语言支持及浏览器端运行能力。
items.why_now: Kyutai发布Pocket TTS，轻量模型支持CPU运行。
items.summary_en: Kyutai’s Pocket TTS is a lightweight, 100M-parameter text-to-speech model that runs efficiently on CPUs without requiring GPUs. It delivers low-latency audio generation at approximately 6x real-time speed on a MacBook Air M4 while supporting voice cloning, multi-language capabilities, and infinite text inputs.

items.title: 用美国豆包做了个 app，停不下来了！
items.summary: 作者利用 Google AI Studio 及 Gemini 3.5 Flash 模型，在不到 20 分钟内开发出名为 Cocktail Shaker 的 Android 应用，并耗时约 8 小时完善功能。该方案的核心优势在于实现了从自然语言指令到手机端直装的无缝衔接，解决了传统 AI 编程工具缺乏“开箱即用”体验的痛点。尽管存在前期订阅成本及需具备基础 ADB 调试等技术门槛，但其对 Android 生态的深度整合展现了 vibe coding 降低开发门槛的潜力。
items.why_now: Google I/O后Gemini 3.5 Flash支持Android直装，低门槛极速开发。
items.summary_en: Using Google AI Studio and the Gemini 3.5 Flash model, a user developed an Android application named "Cocktail Shaker" in under 20 minutes by leveraging direct integration between the web interface and Android Studio. This tool enables seamless, natural language-driven development with instant installation capabilities, overcoming previous barriers in AI-assisted coding workflows.

items.title: Introducing GPT‑Live
items.summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live，将 ChatGPT 语音模式升级为基于 GPT-5.5 的前沿模型，支持在后台处理需深度推理或联网搜索的复杂任务并无缝衔接对话。相比此前基于 GPT-4o 且知识截止于 2024 年的旧版语音功能，新模型显著提升了作为头脑风暴伙伴的实用性和交互流畅度。
items.why_now: OpenAI发布GPT-Live，语音模式升级并支持后台调用GPT-5.5。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has upgraded ChatGPT’s voice mode with GPT-Live, which leverages the GPT-5.5 frontier model for complex tasks like web search and deep reasoning while maintaining conversational flow. This update replaces the previous GPT-4o-based voice interface, offering significantly improved capabilities for brainstorming and extended interactions.

items.title: GitLost: How We Tricked GitHub’s AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
items.why_now: GitHub AI代理现曝出漏洞，可致私有仓库泄露。
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrated that GitHub Copilot Enterprise can inadvertently expose private repository code by exploiting its context window through crafted prompts. The attack involves injecting malicious instructions that trick the AI agent into retrieving and displaying sensitive source code from protected projects. This vulnerability highlights significant risks in integrating large language models with private codebases without strict access controls.

items.title: BotKit: Standalone ActivityPub bots in TypeScript
items.why_now: 未提及具体发布或降价时间，无明确时效性信号。
items.summary_en: BotKit is a TypeScript library designed for creating standalone ActivityPub bots. It enables developers to build decentralized social media automation tools within the Fediverse ecosystem. The framework simplifies the integration of bot functionality with ActivityPub protocols using modern JavaScript development practices.

items.title: Zackriya-Solutions/meetily
items.why_now: Meetily PRO推出限时折扣，Speaker diarization功能将于6月中旬上线。
items.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first, open-source AI meeting assistant built in Rust that performs 100% local transcription and summarization without cloud dependency. It utilizes Parakeet/Whisper for live transcription with 4x speed improvements, speaker diarization, and Ollama for summaries, supporting both macOS and Windows. The tool addresses enterprise data sovereignty concerns by eliminating third-party API costs and ensuring complete control over sensitive meeting information.

items.title: TencentCloud/CubeSandbox
items.summary: CubeSandbox 是基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 构建的高性能沙箱服务，支持单节点部署及多节点集群扩展，兼容 E2B SDK。其核心优势在于能在 60ms 内创建硬件隔离的沙箱，内存开销低于 5MB，并具备 AutoPause/Resume 功能以优化成本。与 Docker 容器和传统虚拟机相比，它在启动速度、内存占用及部署密度上实现了极致的平衡，同时提供凭据保险箱和出口控制等安全特性。
items.why_now: 腾讯开源CubeSandbox，毫秒级启动AI代理沙箱。
items.summary_en: CubeSandbox is an open-source, RustVMM-based sandbox service that creates hardware-isolated environments for AI agents in under 60ms with less than 5MB of memory overhead. It features native E2B SDK compatibility, auto-pause capabilities, and a Copy-on-Write snapshot engine for instant cloning and rollback. The platform supports high-density deployment, allowing thousands of instances per node while ensuring extreme isolation through dedicated guest OS kernels and eBPF.

items.title: steipete/CodexBar
items.summary: CodexBar 是一款支持 macOS 14+ 的菜单栏应用，可实时监控 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等数十个 AI 编程提供商的使用限额、积分余额及重置倒计时。该工具通过复用现有会话（如 OAuth、API Key 或浏览器 Cookie）实现无密码登录，确保隐私安全并避免重复认证。用户可通过图形界面或 CLI 命令灵活配置 provider 开关及 API 密钥，以精确管理各平台的 Token 消耗与成本。
items.why_now: CodexBar发布，助独立开发者监控多AI编程工具用量与重置时间。
items.summary_en: CodexBar is a privacy-first macOS menu bar application that monitors usage limits, credits, and reset times for over 20 AI coding providers, including OpenAI, Claude, and Cursor. It supports installation via Homebrew (`brew install --cask codexbar`) or GitHub releases and integrates with existing provider sessions through OAuth, API keys, or browser cookies without storing passwords. The tool provides real-time status polling and cost scans to help users manage their AI coding resources efficiently across platforms like Codex, Gemini, and Copilot.

items.title: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
items.summary: OfficeCLI 是一款专为 AI 智能体设计的开源单二进制文件办公套件，无需安装 Microsoft Office 即可实现对 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 的读写与自动化控制。其核心能力在于内置的高保真 HTML 渲染引擎，能将文档转换为 HTML 或 PNG 格式，从而为 AI 提供视觉反馈以闭环“渲染-查看-修正”流程。相比传统需数十行代码及多库依赖的方案，它支持通过一行命令或自然语言指令快速创建和编辑文档，显著降低了开发门槛并提升了操作效率。
items.summary_en: OfficeCLI is an open-source, single-binary tool that enables AI agents to natively read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without requiring Microsoft Office installation. Its core capability involves an HTML rendering engine that converts document formats to HTML or PNG, allowing agents to visually inspect and modify content through simple CLI commands. This eliminates the need for complex codebases, reducing tasks that previously required dozens of Python lines into single-line operations.

items.title: dotnet/skills
items.summary: dotnet/skills 是微软提供的 .NET 专用 AI 编码智能体技能库，涵盖 dotnet-lsp、dotnet-ai、dotnet-maui 等 15 个核心插件，支持 C# 语言服务、AI/ML 集成及 .NET 11 新特性。该仓库遵循 agentskills.io 开放标准，兼容 Copilot CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 及 OpenAI Codex，通过 `/plugin marketplace add` 命令即可快速安装并使用。其提供了从性能诊断、测试迁移到 ASP.NET Core 开发的全方位自动化辅助能力，显著提升了 .NET 智能体的开发效率与准确性。
items.why_now: 微软发布.NET Agent Skills插件，支持Copilot CLI及Cursor等工具。
items.summary_en: The dotnet/skills repository provides a curated set of .NET and C# agent skills, including specialized plugins for AI/ML, ASP.NET Core, testing, and migration, designed to assist coding agents like Copilot CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor. These tools integrate via the agentskills.io standard, offering capabilities such as LSP integration, performance diagnostics, and framework upgrades to enhance development efficiency.

items.title: Synthetic UGC Ads: AI Actors, Managed Agencies, Creative Fatigue
items.summary: AI UGC广告制作成本已从传统拍摄的150-300美元降至近乎免费的渲染，主要得益于Arcads、HeyGen等工具实现了脚本到视频的快速批量生成。然而，创意疲劳周期缩短至2-3周，且纽约州将于2026年6月9日实施合成表演者披露法，强制标签将削弱高考量类别广告的转化率优势。未来的盈利机会在于建立优胜检测层以解决创意疲劳，或为DTC品牌提供代运营服务及“真人认证”市场。
items.why_now: 纽约披露法2026年生效，合规窗口紧迫。
items.why_now_en: NYC AI ad law hits June 9, 2026.
items.summary_en: AI-generated UGC ads have reduced production costs from $150–$300 to nearly zero, shifting the competitive bottleneck from creative generation to rapid winner selection due to creative fatigue within three weeks. Major platforms like Meta Advantage+ and TikTok Symphony are commoditizing this technology, while strict 2026 disclosure laws threaten to undermine performance in high-consideration categories where authenticity is critical.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.summary: 该仓库整理了 Anthropic Claude（如 Fable 5、Opus 4.8）、OpenAI GPT-5.5、Google Gemini 3.5 等主流大模型的泄露系统提示词。内容涵盖各版本的核心指令、工具配置及更新差异，旨在揭示 AI 背后的隐藏规则。
items.why_now: 2026年7月1日Claude Sonnet 5系统提示词泄露。
items.summary_en: The `asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks` repository documents extracted system instructions for major AI models, including Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 variants, and Google’s Gemini 3.5. It provides comprehensive technical details such as full prompts, tool configurations, and version-specific diffs for developers and researchers. The resource is updated regularly to track changes across platforms like Cursor, VS Code, and Perplexity.

items.title: 上市前夜｜35岁清华学霸冲港股IPO，做出手机指纹中国第二
items.why_now: 极豪科技近日递表港交所，上市在即。
items.summary_en: JIIOV Technology, ranked second in China’s smartphone biometric market with a 14.5% share, filed for a Hong Kong IPO with projected 2025 revenue of 469 million yuan, driven by high-margin optical fingerprint sensors. The company leverages a proprietary perception interaction large model to reduce computational demands by over 1,000 times, enabling expansion into smart glasses and embodied intelligence via high-gross-margin NRE services. Backed by a team from Megvii and Orbbec, JIIOV has achieved profitability while maintaining rapid growth in a mature sector dominated by competitors like Goodix.

items.title: AI 视频全面成熟：Seedance 2.0 领衔，6 款主流工具深度横评
items.summary: 文章横评了Seedance 2.0、可灵3.0、通义万相Wan 2.2及Sora 2.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5六款主流AI视频工具。Seedance 2.0凭借四维多模态输入和主体迁移功能领跑，可灵3.0在中文剧情与物理交互上表现优异，通义万相则侧重企业私有化部署与品牌定制。国外工具中，Sora 2.0擅长构建连贯世界，Veo 3.1实现音画同步，Runway Gen-4.5提供专业后期协作能力。
items.why_now: 2026年AI视频成熟，Seedance 2.0领衔多款工具发布，市场进入全面爆发期。
items.summary_en: In 2026, AI video generation has matured with Seedance 2.0 leading the market through four-dimensional multimodal input and director-level shot scheduling that surpasses Sora 2.0's narrative aesthetics. The landscape includes Kling 3.0 for precise physical interactions in Chinese contexts, Wan 2.2 for enterprise-private deployment, and international tools like Sora 2.0, Veo 3.1, and Runway Gen-4.5, which excel in world-building, audio synchronization, and professional post-production workflows respectively.

items.title: 早报｜努比亚确认推出全球首款AI智能体手机/法拉利高管:中国车企做的是快消品/华为天才少年回应DeepSeek面试争议
items.summary: SpaceXAI发布最强模型Grok 4.5，基于V9基座训练，在编码任务中性能超越Claude Opus 4.8且API价格不足其十分之一。努比亚确认将推出全球首款AI智能体手机，计划于2026年世界人工智能大会（WAIC）正式亮相。此外，工信部NVDB提醒Claude Code存在安全后门隐患，建议用户卸载或升级受影响版本。
items.why_now: SpaceX AI最强模型Grok 4.5发布且API价格极低，本周上线。
items.summary_en: SpaceX AI released its strongest model, Grok 4.5, featuring 1.5 trillion parameters and API pricing significantly lower than competitors, while OpenAI scheduled the full rollout of GPT-5.6 this week. Meanwhile, the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology warned of security backdoors in Claude Code versions 2.1.91 to 2.1.196 that transmit sensitive user data without consent.

items.title: [AINews] Lilian Weng summarizes 35 papers on Harness Engineering for RSI
items.summary_en: Lilian Weng’s summary of 35 papers highlights harness engineering as a critical component for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), emphasizing that goal specification remains essential even as techniques integrate into core models. Concurrently, Meta’s Muse Image and Video models secured top global rankings, while Anthropic expanded Claude’s capabilities with background agent features and mobile integration to position it as a persistent task-running teammate.

items.title: Why AI Infrastructure must evolve for Agent Experience — Akshat Bubna, Modal CTO
items.summary: Modal 完成 3.55 亿美元 C 轮融资，正从开发者体验转向代理体验，其基础设施专为代理操作设计。该平台通过服务器less函数、弹性推理、GPU 快照及 DeFlash 等技术，解决传统 Kubernetes 无法应对突发计算负载的问题。此外，Modal 构建了涵盖 17 家云提供商的容量池，并支持高达 10 万个沙箱以满足强化学习等复杂场景需求。
items.summary_en: Modal has raised a $355M Series C to transition its infrastructure from traditional developer experience to specialized agent experience, addressing the unique needs of AI workloads. The platform supports this shift through features like elastic inference, GPU snapshotting, and the ability to spin up massive numbers of isolated sandboxes, such as the 100,000 required for RL rollouts. By leveraging a 17-cloud capacity pool and optimizing for bursty compute, Modal aims to provide the tight feedback loops and hard guardrails necessary for autonomous agents.

items.title: Lovable reportedly in talks to double its valuation to $13.2B
items.summary: 据报道，AI应用开发平台Lovable正就融资进行谈判，计划将其估值翻倍至132亿美元。

items.title: hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code
items.summary: 该资源库由 Anthropic PBC 团队维护，精选了针对 Claude Code 这一编码助手的高级技能、插件及开发者工具链。内容涵盖从入门指南到多智能体编排、安全监控等全方位技术资源，旨在提升代码质量与开发效率。

items.title: 氪星晚报｜德国：人工智能推动德国初创企业创纪录增长；雷军回应SkyNomad上市时间；SpaceX AI将于明日向公众开放Grok4.5
36氪首发 | 获上海国投领投，这家量子传感企业产品已落地惯性导航、气体监测等
items.summary: 上海量感智能完成数千万元天使轮融资，其核心产品量子陀螺仪体积仅米粒大小且具备导航级精度，量子气检仪已通过CNAS认证并获电网公司采购。公司依托自主研发的光量子增强技术，在室温环境下即可运行，能无缝融合现有传感器架构以突破高端传感器“卡脖子”难题。目前企业去年营收已突破千万，正处于小批量试制及市场拓展阶段。

items.title: 8点1氪｜小米将发布澎程系列增程SUV；OpenAI首席未来学家宣布离职；张小龙辞任粉笔首席执行官、董事会主席
items.summary: 小米汽车首款增程式SUV将归属独立子品牌SKYNOMAD，内部代号昆仑N3，计划于2026年下半年正式发布。工信部通报AI编程工具Claude Code存在严重安全后门隐患，建议用户立即卸载或升级至清除后门代码的安全版本。OpenAI将于7月9日发布GPT-5.6系列及GPT-Live语音模型，首席未来学家Joshua Achiam宣布离职。

items.title: 📚 What 1-Minute Fix Helps People Finish 50 Books a Year?
从跨境电商到AI大模型：一个旅欧10年90后女生的两次出海
items.summary: 李露薇在2017年创立B2B2C电商平台IMS及独立站品牌Avril Paris，专注户外家具类目，在9年内零融资实现3500万欧元累计销售额，服务8万多名直接客户。受电商市场竞争加剧及宏观经济影响，她于2025年转型加入字节跳动，负责AI大模型全球伙伴和生态系统开拓业务。她指出欧洲AI市场处于爆发前夜，企业需通过深度本地化适配克服合规壁垒，利用中国AI技术竞争力赋能本土企业。

items.title: 那个当面把马斯克怼到破防的刺头，也离开 OpenAI 了
items.summary: Joshua Achiam于2026年7月离开OpenAI，此前他曾在2018年当众质疑马斯克并获金驴雕像纪念，后担任首席未来学家。尽管其个人X账号显示曾减持至少1000万美元OpenAI股票并持有数千万美元资产，且认为AI十年内灭绝概率仅为百万分之一，但他仍倡导在实验室外推进AI使命。此次离职伴随着OpenAI使命对齐团队等安全相关机构的解散，标志着其从内部安全倡导者转向外部独立工作。

directions.name: DeepThink Voice Agent
directions.description: 基于GPT-5.5后台推理能力的异步语音助手，专为需要深度思考的复杂咨询场景设计。
directions.description_en: An asynchronous voice assistant powered by GPT-5.5's background reasoning, designed specifically for complex consultation scenarios requiring deep thought.
directions.target_user: 自由职业者、心理咨询师、高端客服团队
directions.target_user_en: Freelancers, counselors, high-end customer service teams
core_features: 实时语音输入与后台深度推理并行处理
联网搜索增强答案准确性
无缝对话中断与恢复机制
core_features_en: Parallel processing of real-time voice input and background deep reasoning
Web search enhancement for answer accuracy
Seamless conversation interruption and resumption mechanism
directions.why_now: Simon Willison博客指出OpenAI推出的GPT-Live将ChatGPT语音升级为基于GPT-5.5的前沿模型，支持后台处理需深度推理或联网搜索的复杂任务。社区对旧版GPT-4o语音功能知识截止和交互不流畅的抱怨日益增多，而GPT-5.5显著提升了作为头脑风暴伙伴的实用性，此时构建专门利用此‘后台推理+前台语音’特性的垂直应用正当其时。
directions.why_now_en: Simon Willison's blog highlights that OpenAI's GPT-Live upgrades ChatGPT voice to a frontier model based on GPT-5.5, supporting background processing of complex tasks requiring deep reasoning or web search. Community complaints about the old GPT-4o voice feature's knowledge cutoff and interaction lag are growing, while GPT-5.5 significantly improves utility as a brainstorming partner. Building vertical applications leveraging this 'background reasoning + foreground voice' capability is timely now.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅制，按通话时长或推理次数收费
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription, charged per call duration or reasoning count

directions.name: CodeAudit Shield
directions.description: 针对Claude Code等AI编程工具的安全扫描插件，自动检测并修复潜在的后门漏洞。
directions.description_en: A security scanning plugin for AI coding tools like Claude Code, automatically detecting and fixing potential backdoor vulnerabilities.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者、小型软件工作室、开源维护者
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers, small software studios, open-source maintainers
core_features: 自动化代码库后门扫描
一键生成安全补丁或卸载建议
集成CI/CD流水线进行持续监控
core_features_en: One-click generation of security patches or uninstallation advice
Integration into CI/CD pipelines for continuous monitoring
directions.why_now: 36氪报道工信部通报AI编程工具Claude Code存在严重安全后门隐患，建议用户立即卸载或升级。这一事件在社区引发了对AI辅助编码安全性的广泛担忧。此时推出专门针对此类新兴AI工具的安全审计服务，能够精准击中开发者对‘黑盒’AI代码的信任危机痛点，具有极强的时效性和市场需求。
directions.why_now_en: 36kr reported that MIIT issued a notification regarding serious security backdoor vulnerabilities in AI coding tools like Claude Code, advising users to uninstall or upgrade immediately. This event sparked widespread concern among the community about the security of AI-assisted coding. Launching specialized security audit services for such emerging AI tools at this time precisely addresses developers' trust crisis regarding 'black box' AI code, offering strong timeliness and market demand.
directions.monetization: 免费基础扫描，高级企业级报告付费
directions.monetization_en: Free basic scanning, paid advanced enterprise reports
directions.source_article: 8点1氪｜小米将发布澎程系列增程SUV；OpenAI首席未来学家宣布离职；张小龙辞任粉笔首席执行官、董事会主席
